miHelper: Helper Functions to Combine Multiparameter Multiple Imputation Estimates

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/miHelper.Rmd
miHelper.Rmd

Description

Helper functions to combine multiparameter multiple imputation estimates in R (R Core Team, 2026): a multivariate version of Rubin’s rules (Rubin, 1987) and the adjustment proposed by Li et al. (1991). Models are fitted on the imputed data sets from mice, Amelia, or norm2 (MIFit()) and pooled with MICombine().

Installation

You can install the development version of miHelper from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/miHelper")

Example 

library(package = "miHelper")
fit <- stats::lm(
  formula = Temp ~ .,
  data = datasets::airquality
)
M <- 5

Fit the model on each imputed data set and combine the estimates. The data sets are imputed with mice (fun = "mice"), Amelia (fun = "amelia"), or norm2 (fun = "mcmcNorm").

set.seed(seed = 42)
mifit <- MIFit(
  x = datasets::airquality,
  fit = fit,
  fun = "mice",
  M = M
)
MICombine(object = mifit)$est
#> (Intercept)       Ozone     Solar.R        Wind       Month         Day 
#> 58.65631109  0.15818814  0.01015689 -0.27512146  2.12400831 -0.08638201

Use the adjustment of Li, Raghunathan, and Rubin (1991).

MICombine(
  object = mifit,
  adj = TRUE
)$total_adj
#>              (Intercept)         Ozone       Solar.R          Wind
#> (Intercept) 15.467881214 -2.449691e-02 -6.395809e-03 -0.4277602967
#> Ozone       -0.024496906  4.565797e-04 -4.769669e-05  0.0021167361
#> Solar.R     -0.006395809 -4.769669e-05  3.967331e-05 -0.0001614201
#> Wind        -0.427760297  2.116736e-03 -1.614201e-04  0.0330784889
#> Month       -1.093799471 -9.379750e-04  2.461951e-04  0.0061931100
#> Day         -0.067640752 -9.555539e-06  5.542167e-05 -0.0001924534
#>                     Month           Day
#> (Intercept) -1.0937994708 -6.764075e-02
#> Ozone       -0.0009379750 -9.555539e-06
#> Solar.R      0.0002461951  5.542167e-05
#> Wind         0.0061931100 -1.924534e-04
#> Month        0.1458769345  3.157421e-04
#> Day          0.0003157421  3.632316e-03

References

Li, K. H., Raghunathan, T. E., & Rubin, D. B. (1991). Large-sample significance levels from multiply imputed data using moment-based statistics and an F reference distribution. Journal of the American Statistical Association, 86(416), 1065–1073. https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.1991.10475152
R Core Team. (2026). R: A language and environment for statistical computing. R Foundation for Statistical Computing. https://www.R-project.org/
Rubin, D. B. (1987). Multiple imputation for nonresponse in surveys. John Wiley & Sons, Inc. https://doi.org/10.1002/9780470316696
